goal: Make canonical Intent authoring discoverable and complete GitHub publication safely recover from confirmed partial writes or uncertain responses within a whole-operation deadline.

acceptance.assertion: Implement S5 of docs/specs/workflow-decision-closure.spec.md in existing public command guidance and GitHub tracker transport/publication seams, preserving strict v2 parsing and exclusive canonical authoring. State destination/stdin/example structure before error probing. Report confirmed writes, unfinished steps and uncertain outcomes truthfully; read back exact ownership/topology and intent hashes before same-manifest idempotent recovery. Bound the entire publication without a blind outer shell loop. Fake-transport tests cover partial success, lost response, stale or ambiguous ownership/hash, timeout/cancellation and repeat publication, proving no duplicate or wrong-owner mutation and no execution handoff before complete success. Preserve existing negative controls and one specific recovery action. Regenerate the Claude bundle and pass focused runtime/package checks and typecheck before Review. No real remote test writes, authority schema/reducer/store changes, new scheduler or automatic native-gate retry.
